inputs.text: You won't believe the latest from the powers that be – they passed Bill C-12, the so-called Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, with royal assent on March 26, 2026, and now they're using it to tighten immigration and asylum rules against Nigerians and others. Don't fall for the official story about border security or whatever they're claiming. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, selectively targeting groups like Nigerians to push their concealed agenda while flipping the narrative to make it sound protective and necessary.
